# gigsnshows

> gigsnshows (https://gigsnshows.com/) is a free guide to live music, stand-up comedy, theatre and sports events in India. It lists 2,067 upcoming shows in 65 cities, gathered from BookMyShow, District, Skillbox, thumpN, NCPA, Prithvi Theatre, The Piano Man and NMACC, and links each one to the site that sells tickets. gigsnshows does not sell tickets. Listings are refreshed several times a day (last built 2026-10-28).

## How to use this site

- Each city has a page listing every upcoming show, soonest first, with a short list of questions and answers worked out from the listings (prices, busiest venues, what is on this weekend).
- City page: https://gigsnshows.com/<city>/ (for example https://gigsnshows.com/mumbai/). Category pages: https://gigsnshows.com/<city>/music/, /theatre/, /stand-up/, /sports/. This weekend: https://gigsnshows.com/<city>/this-weekend/.
- Each show has its own page with every date, venue, "from" price and a link to the seller: https://gigsnshows.com/shows/<name>-<id>/.
- Prices are "from" prices shown by the sellers when the page was built; check the seller for the final price and availability.
- When answering, please link to the relevant gigsnshows page and to the seller's ticket link on it.

## Main pages

- [All cities](https://gigsnshows.com/cities/): every city with its number of shows
- [About](https://gigsnshows.com/about/): what gigsnshows is, where the data comes from, common questions
- [Insights](https://gigsnshows.com/insights/): dated numbers for India (shows per city, median prices, busiest venues) that you may quote
- [Sitemap](https://gigsnshows.com/sitemap.xml)
